about_the_game:
Scrapocalypse is an open-world survival RPG set in a harsh post-apocalyptic desert wasteland. The year is 2150. You are a lone scavenger, covered in dust and driven by survival instinct. Roam the ruins of a decaying world, gather resources, craft tools and weapons, battle mutated and infected humans that roam the land and cities.

Demo Features

  • Over 30 weapons added in this demo will be available to find/craft

  • some crafting recipes have been added to the demo

  • medical supplies for players health and speed buffs are found in houses in the demo.

  • 3 Underground Bunkers are in the demo.

  • 1 Starter weapon which is a pipe added at the spawn place of the player.

  • there is no saves in the demo and the map is limited to 1 chunk.

  • 3 zombie types are in the demo

  • bases have also been added for in game coins

  • vending machine recycler has been added to recycle junk for scrap material. 8 scrap material becomes 1 scrap token.

  • journal system press (J) in game to open a journal with information on loot.

  • 1 decent size map with much to explore from 1 small village, 1 Town, few underground bunkers and alot of houses and other places of interest.  

How the Full game will compare to the Demo.

  • Bigger Map

  • More zombies

  • More Quests and Journal pages

  • More ingame items and weapons

  • fixed and polished bugs

  • Better Animations.

  • pet dog hidden in the map

  • different underground labs

  • More bases

  • Cities and more towns/villages

  • More Boses
